Fey

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Fey

Fey, fairies or faeries, dwell in the Fey-Realm and have a relationship with the elves. The Bound Bargainers (a faction of the elves) make gifts to and contracts with the fey; even the Bloodied King has contracts he must keep (including an annual delivery of human babies).

The Holt has many doors because of a clever agreement made by an elfmaid with a prince of the fey. Category:Creatures Category:Fey Category:Elves Category:Planes
